content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed to handle massive amounts of data efficiently. It allows digital creators to store and deliver files such as ebooks, courses, and templates without incurring the high fees associated with traditional platforms like Gumroad. With R2, creators benefit from low costs, especially when compared to the 10% fees charged by Gumroad — a stark contrast to the 0.5% fee from NOWPayments. This means that with a product priced at $97 and 100 sales a month, a creator retains an additional $921. This infrastructure not only reduces costs but also empowers creators to maintain complete control over their products and customer interactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery is built on a robust infrastructure that integrates seamlessly with other tools. Cloudflare R2 stores your digital products while Cloudflare Workers handle the logic needed for order processing and delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the transaction, allowing for instantaneous payment confirmation. This entire process is automated, ensuring that customers receive their products immediately after payment, which enhances user experience and satisfaction. Furthermore, using technologies like Supabase for order management provides a reliable backend that keeps your operations running smoothly, free from the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in markets where payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are not viable options. Individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can utilize Cloudflare R2 to create a fully functional online store without relying on conventional platforms. This architecture caters to those who prioritize control, ownership, and cost efficiency. By using Cloudflare R2, creators can establish a sustainable business model that is not dependent on third-party platforms, enabling them to focus on creating rather than navigating financial barriers.
Cloudflare R2 offers a cost-effective solution for digital product storage.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, a combination of several components is essential. At the core, Cloudflare R2 serves as the storage solution, while Cloudflare Workers execute the backend logic required for managing orders and delivery processes. Connecting these components, NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions, offering a vast array of payment options without buyer account requirements. Additionally, using Supabase for order management ensures that all transactions are efficiently recorded and managed. This comprehensive stack allows creators to deliver their products reliably and securely, without any reliance on traditional payment gateways.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store using Cloudflare R2, start by signing up for a Cloudflare account. Next, set up your R2 storage for your digital files. Utilize Cloudflare Workers to create the necessary logic for processing orders and delivering products. Integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you configure payment verification correctly. After setting up Supabase for order management, load your products and test the entire flow. You can leverage the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a streamlined deployment, which includes configuration support and testing. Once everything is set, launch your store and start selling.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by establishing a digital store using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This setup allows you to keep more profit by significantly reducing transaction fees, making it an efficient alternative to traditional platforms that impose high charges.
Use NOWPayments to retain more profit from each sale with low transaction fees.

This stack provides you with the tools needed to establish your store on your terms. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to set up your own infrastructure using Cloudflare R2, complemented by NOWPayments. This setup minimizes costs and maximizes control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without Gumroad or Payhip by utilizing Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing payments. This allows you to retain full ownership of your transactions.
How does NOWPayments compare to traditional payment platforms?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by platforms like Gumroad. This cost efficiency enables you to retain more revenue from each sale.
What infrastructure do I need to get started?

To get started, you need a Cloudflare account, access to Cloudflare R2 for storage, and NOWPayments for transaction processing. Additionally, consider using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for a complete system.
